introHtml: New Era outerwear offers the same quality and style trusted by professional sports leagues. When you choose custom New Era outerwear for your team or corporate event, you get durable jackets and pullovers that hold up to daily wear. The Cage Short Sleeve 1/4-Zip Jacket is a popular choice for outdoor events and trade shows, with plenty of room for your logo through embroidery or screen printing.
